catalog_label: DEMO / SYNTHETIC DATA — DEMO COST ASSUMPTIONS — NOT VERIFIED PMC/PCMC PRICES
cost_basis: Illustrative per-block software-testing inputs only; no municipal tender, bill of quantities, supplier quote, or Pune unit rate has been verified.
co_benefit_scale: DEMO ordinal score 0–5 for software testing; not a validated health, biodiversity, or social-benefit measure.

interventions.name: Street Trees
interventions.time_horizon: After planted canopy is established; growth years and survival are not modeled.
interventions.assumptions: DEMO AREA AND COST ASSUMPTIONS: one tree uses a 3 m by 3 m plantable ground block; green-cover gain is illustrative, not measured mature crown area.
interventions.source_reference: User Step 21: one-tree block; GreenPulse research PDF: intervention catalog concept; no verified PMC/PCMC cost source.

interventions.name: Cool Roofs
interventions.time_horizon: After retrofit under comparable March–May daytime satellite-overpass conditions; coating aging is not modeled.
interventions.assumptions: DEMO COST ASSUMPTIONS: one discrete block retrofits 50 m2 of verified eligible roof; only roof area changes.
interventions.source_reference: User Step 21: 50 m2 cool-roof block; GreenPulse research PDF: cool-roof intervention concept; no verified PMC/PCMC cost source.

interventions.name: Green Roofs
interventions.time_horizon: After installation and establishment; structural suitability and plant survival are not modeled.
interventions.assumptions: DEMO AREA AND COST ASSUMPTIONS: one 25 m2 block needs verified structural roof capacity; green-cover gain assumes full planted coverage.
interventions.source_reference: User Step 21: 25 m2 green-roof block; GreenPulse research PDF: green-roof intervention concept; no verified PMC/PCMC cost source.

interventions.name: Shade Structures
interventions.time_horizon: After installation; shade geometry and pedestrian thermal comfort are not modeled.
interventions.assumptions: DEMO AREA AND COST ASSUMPTIONS: one structure reserves a 25 m2 ground site; shade benefit and uncertainty require a separate model.
interventions.source_reference: GreenPulse research PDF: shade intervention concept; block size and costs are DEMO ASSUMPTIONS; no verified PMC/PCMC source.

interventions.name: Green Corridors
interventions.time_horizon: After corridor vegetation is established; plant survival and network connectivity are not modeled.
interventions.assumptions: DEMO AREA AND COST ASSUMPTIONS: one 25 m2 ground block is fully vegetated; cooling and uncertainty require local evidence.
interventions.source_reference: GreenPulse research PDF: green-corridor intervention concept; block size and costs are DEMO ASSUMPTIONS; no verified PMC/PCMC source.

interventions.name: Reflective Pavements
interventions.time_horizon: After resurfacing; material aging, glare, and maintenance effects are not modeled.
interventions.assumptions: DEMO COST ASSUMPTIONS: one 50 m2 ground block needs verified eligible pavement; no cooling estimate is available.
interventions.source_reference: User Step 21: 50 m2 cool-pavement block; GreenPulse research PDF: reflective-pavement intervention concept; no verified PMC/PCMC cost source.
